newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 22.9750 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 22.9750 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate rose by 33.50 basis points to 22.9750 percent on Wednesday, from 22.64 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The 91-day TIIE meanwhile fell 52.50 basis points to 23.7350 percent from 24.26 percent the week before.
The TIIP fell 60.43 basis points to 22.9735 percent on Tuesday from 23.5778 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
